author: Polar_Express
body:
Folks, here is a very different type of walls map.. I call it the "Dark Wood" for only 2 - teams , very different structure, a few npcs, new enchants/effects, totally enclosed map - to give a new feel... Very little mining on this map ( only in the hidden mine ). Middle looks lots different ( no screen shot ) - no OP bow... but the game has a much better feel / flow to it. 15min gear up time.. up to two teams of 20 on the map.Tell me what you think. I have not started on the YML. Any map devs that see this tell me what you think... Dropbox link below.. https://www.dropbox.com/s/cyhnt85gm4iahi3/Dark_Wood_Finished_ver_3.zip ( Map )2014-07-05_23.15.17.png ( start )2014-07-05_23.16.16.png ( manor )2014-07-05_23.16.35.png ( over view )
Each side is a little bigger than the size of two quads... I think it could be a really fun map. let me know if ya like it and if I should start on the YML.
